name: How much does cabinet refinishing cost in the Berkeley area?
description: Cabinet refinishing costs in Berkeley depend on cabinet count, size, wood type, and finish, with custom options increasing the price.

mainEntity.name: How much does cabinet refinishing cost in the Berkeley area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of cabinet refinishing in the Berkeley area varies depending on several factors, including the number of cabinets, their size, the type of wood, and the chosen finish. Custom finishes or extensive repairs will also impact the price. It's best to get a detailed quote after an on-site assessment to understand the specific costs for your project. Generally, refinishing is more cost-effective than full cabinet replacement.
